chunks: He will show them the way, and better their state,
ai.seo_question: What does God promise to do for those He guides?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual aspect of divine favor: intellectual guidance (hidayah) and practical rectification (islah) of the believers' affairs. It underscores that true success in this world and the hereafter is contingent upon God's active intervention to resolve their spiritual and worldly difficulties, a concept often linked to the Imams as the inheritors of this guidance.
